outcome: total unit of packed red blood cell (pRBC) transfusion
success rate of TAE in controlling PPH and preserving the uterus
cohort: The study included all women with acute PPH more than 1500 cc and/or DIC from a single tertiary referral center.
finding: Transarterial embolization (TAE) is safe and effective in controlling severe postpartum hemorrhage (PPH), achieving an 80% success rate in preserving the uterus and preventing DIC, with a significantly lower hysterectomy rate compared to not receiving TAE.
